name: Trimble
description: Trimble sells software, positioning and measurement technology, and data services to construction, geospatial and transportation customers. Three segments: AECO (subscription software for architects, engineers, contractors and owners), Field Systems (software-driven 3D measurement, positioning and imaging for the field) and Transportation & Logistics (freight and transport management software, mainly the Transporeon platform). It has shifted to recurring revenue (annualised recurring revenue $2.39 billion, +6%, organic +14%) and sold its Mobility telematics business in February 2025. Its auditor gave an adverse opinion on internal control over financial reporting for FY2025.

employees.note: "Over 11,500" full-time and part-time employees at end of 2025; 41% North America, 35% Europe, 21% Asia-Pacific.

businessLines.name: AECO (architecture, engineering, construction and owners)
businessLines.how: Annual subscriptions to construction-lifecycle software (construction management, architecture and design, MEP), renewed each year; many renewals fall on January 1.

businessLines.name: Field Systems
businessLines.how: Sells software-driven 3D measurement, positioning and imaging solutions to field professionals; the split between device sales and subscriptions is not stated in the text read.

businessLines.name: Transportation & Logistics (T&L)
businessLines.how: Software subscriptions and platform fees from shippers and carriers for transportation management and freight matching (Transporeon); the 10-K cites network effects from connecting shipper and carrier systems.

brands.name: SketchUp
brands.note: Named in 10-K; revenue not broken out.

brands.name: Transporeon
brands.note: Core of the T&L segment; revenue not broken out separately.

brands.name: Platform Science (minority stake)
brands.note: Mobility business sold to Platform Science 2025-02-08; Trimble kept a minority stake and commercial relationships.
